meta.name: Send internal due-action alerts from Airtable via Gmail without duplicates

name: Alert humans about due Airtable actions without duplicate notifications

parameters.content:
## Alert humans about due Airtable actions without duplicate notifications

### How it works

This workflow runs every 10 minutes or can be started manually for testing. It searches Airtable for records whose actions are due, filters out records that have already triggered an alert, and sends an internal Gmail notification only for new due items.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Schedule Trigger interval if 10 minutes is not the desired polling frequency.
- Connect Airtable credentials and set the correct base, table, view or filter formula for due action records.
- Review the duplicate-prevention code so it matches the Airtable fields or state mechanism used to identify already-notified records.
- Connect Gmail credentials and configure the internal recipient, subject, and message body for due alerts.

### Customization

Adjust the Airtable due-date criteria, duplicate tracking rules, and Gmail message template to match the team's action workflow.

## Start workflow checks

Contains the scheduled trigger for automatic polling and a manual trigger for test runs. These two entry nodes are stacked together on the left side of the canvas and both start the same Airtable lookup.

## Find due records

Queries Airtable for records that are due and passes the matching items into the notification filtering step.

## Filter and notify

Uses custom code to prevent duplicate alerts, then sends the remaining due-action notifications through Gmail. These nodes form the right-side processing and output cluster.

parameters.filterByFormula: AND({Next Action At} != BLANK(), {Next Action At} <= NOW(), NOT(OR({Status}='Done',{Status}='Closed',{Status}='Rejected',{Status}='Suppressed')))
